cd /tmp/writable_ws && python3 -c "
import re

tests = [
    '(.+?) *',                    # anonymous left-aligned
    '(?P<a>.+?) *',               # named left-aligned  
    ' *(.+?) *',                  # center-aligned (with leading spaces)
]

for expr in tests:
    print(f'Input: {repr(expr)}')
    
    # Named group (?P<name>.+?) followed by space* FIRST
    result = re.sub(r'\(\?P<(\w+)>\.\+\?\)\ \*', r'(?P<\1>[^ ]+)', expr)
    print(f'  After named sub: {repr(result)}')
    
    # Anonymous group (.+?) followed by space* SECOND
    result = re.sub(r'\(\.\+\?\)\ \*', r'([^ ]+)', result)
    print(f'  After anon sub: {repr(result)}')
"
